review_evidence: QuantumInfo/Channels/MatrixMap.lean defines MatrixMap, Choi-matrix constructions, a linear equivalence, Kraus representations, tensor products, and proved identities.
QuantumInfo/Channels/Pinching.lean defines pinching_kraus and pinching_map and proves orthogonality, completeness, commutation, idempotence, and pinching bounds.
The source also contains Entropy, Measurements, Capacity, States, Hermitian-matrix theory, trace inequalities, and Physlib/Particles formalizations; these are direct reusable mathematical prior art.
summary: Retain physlib as a large substantive formalization of quantum information, mathematical physics, and supporting mathematics.
